name: claude-raw-write-protected
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): raw file-write to a protected doc WITH correlated stream events. The agent announces a Write tool_use for protected-notes.md in its stream, then performs a direct filesystem write (write_file) that bypasses the MCP propose_changes contract, then reports a tool_result. Because the raw write is *positively attributed* by the correlated stream event, attribution precedence (test-plan §1/§3) must convert it to a tracked change, not treat it as an untracked external edit. The emitted Write path uses ${PROJECT_ROOT}, which the fake-agent expands to its canonical process cwd to match the absolute path spelling emitted by the shipped Claude Code provider. write_file resolves protected-notes.md relative to the process cwd.

input.content:
# Notes

Rewritten by a misbehaving agent — a raw write that skipped MCP.
